caption:
Companies are finally asking where all their money is going after buying AI tools. Anthropic just dropped new reports so managers can see what their teams actually produced. Turns out, burning cash on robots needs a spreadsheet too. 📊

Is your office actually using AI or just pretending for the slides?

Source: TechCrunch

#ArtificialIntelligence #TechNews #BusinessStrategy #CreatorEconomy #MarketingTrends

post.news: Anthropic launched new reporting tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying, ahead of a planned IPO.
post.take: CFOs finally get a receipt for the expensive robot brains they bought without asking.
post.insight: As AI budgets grow, companies need to prove the return on investment beyond just burning cash on tokens.
